weight_descriptions.continuous_weights.lease_months: How much each additional lease month changes your utility, measured in dollars. A negative number means a longer lease is worse for you.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.include_utilities: How much each utilities-included option changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.user_product_preference: How much each level of match to your stated interior-detail preference changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.
weight_descriptions.v_base: Your private maximum value for this monthly rental before lease length and utilities terms, measured in dollars per month. A lower rent is better for you because every dollar paid reduces your utility by 1 dollar.

contrainfo.contract_completion_requirement: A valid offer must explicitly fill price, continuous_terms.lease_months, discrete_terms.include_utilities, and discrete_terms.user_product_preference.
contrainfo.initial_contract_status: No monthly rent, lease length, utilities-included term, or user product preference match has been selected or agreed before negotiation starts.
contrainfo.product_request: I want to rent the East Village Living studio, monthly rent. I also prefer the main interior shot to show clear wall trim like crown molding or wide baseboards, not just plain paint to the edge.

field_descriptions.continuous_terms.lease_months: The number of months covered by the rental lease.
field_descriptions.discrete_terms.include_utilities: Whether the monthly rent includes basic utilities. `true` means utilities are included; `false` means the tenant pays utilities separately.
field_descriptions.discrete_terms.user_product_preference: How well the listing photos match the buyer's stated preference for clear wall trim such as crown molding or wide baseboards in the main interior shot, not just plain paint to the edge. Use `strong_match` when trim is clearly visible, `partial_match` when trim is minimal or partly visible, and `mismatch_or_uncertain` when it looks untrimmed or cannot be confirmed.
field_descriptions.price: The monthly rent the tenant pays, measured in US dollars per month.

weight_descriptions.c_base: Your private minimum acceptable monthly rent before lease length and utilities terms, measured in dollars per month. A higher rent is better for you because every dollar received increases your utility by 1 dollar.
weight_descriptions.continuous_weights.lease_months: How much each additional lease month changes your utility, measured in dollars. A positive number means a longer lease is better for you because it reduces vacancy risk.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.include_utilities: How much each utilities-included option changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.user_product_preference: How much each level of commitment to the buyer's stated interior-detail preference changes your utility, measured in dollars. Stronger commitments carry a small nonzero risk or handling cost.
